author: microscope_agent

conflict.statement: a1 needs at least 0.5 s to reach the signal to noise target from scattered light, while a2 caps the exposure at 0.02 s to keep motion blur inside one pixel. The allowed sets do not overlap, so darkfield cannot produce this observable at this tracer size.

rejected.reason: empty intersection between the detection floor and the blur ceiling on exposure time

tie_break: no tie: only one configuration survived the intersection

numbers.name: exposure_time_chosen
numbers.note: the geometric middle of the allowed decade. Picking a point deterministically keeps S4 from introducing a number nobody can trace.

assumptions.statement: Carried from axis_brightfield_a1: read noise puts a floor of order one millisecond on a useful brightfield exposure.
assumptions.falsifier: a usable centroid at a shorter exposure retires this bound

assumptions.statement: Carried from axis_brightfield_a1: motion blur crosses a pixel at tens of milliseconds for the expected diffusivity.
assumptions.falsifier: a measured blur below one pixel at a longer exposure retires this bound

assumptions.statement: Carried from axis_darkfield_a1: darkfield scattering from a two micrometre tracer needs an exposure of order half a second to reach the signal to noise target.
assumptions.falsifier: a centroid at the target signal to noise ratio with a shorter darkfield exposure retires the rejection of darkfield

assumptions.statement: Carried from axis_darkfield_a2: the tracer diffusivity used for the blur ceiling is a bulk order of magnitude, not a measurement.
assumptions.falsifier: a measured diffusivity outside this decade retires the ceiling computed from it
